$comment: Contributors who have accepted CLA.md. A pull request from a login absent here fails the CLA check. Add a login by merging a pull request that appends it, which is itself the record of acceptance: the contributor states in that pull request that they have read and accept CLA.md at the recorded version.

signatures.note: Operator and principal of Full Vibe AI, the grantee. Recorded so the check is honest about who has accepted rather than special-casing an exemption.
